verified_findings: Startup confirms enabled segment tracker, 0.04 rad progress corridor, 1.0 s human timeout and unchanged experimental execution settings.

39 of 54 profiled path_search stages return FALSE; all 39 cross the human-data deadline. The wider launch prints 40 PathPlanner expiry NO_PATH messages, including 38 graph-search and two final-validation expiries. Message counts are not assumed one-to-one with the profiled main stage.
In the bag window, search cycle 555 has 581.610 ms remaining but spends 582.441 ms and ends at -0.844 ms. Four main searches expire and one succeeds in that window.
The bag has 77 valid observed and seven invalid human messages; observed receipt-age median is 0.272817 s. Valid=False is separate from capture-age expiry.
14 of 20 recorded manager STOP actions in the wider log follow VISION_INVALID; three follow fresh-data PATH_COLLISION, two current human proximity, and one retreat-clear cancellation.

The wider Motion log reports five TRACKING_ERROR faults and one STALLED fault. In the bag, Motion enters CONTROL_ERROR at 8.191 s with failure_reason TRACKING_ERROR; subsequent profiles include recovery/no-path and MOTION_ERROR.

Joint-5 fault at 1794851944.963 reports 0.212 rad tracking error, requested velocity 0.724 rad/s and filtered velocity 0.500 rad/s. Saturation is verified; the complete controller/plant cause is not proven.
Current Motion source already uses reference max velocity 0.6 * configured joint speed, with the guard at the full configured speed; do not recommend adding this existing reserve as a new fix.

All five new failed-path traces reject waypoints, rather than the old measured-to-stale-waypoint connector. Four emitted profiles explicitly record accepted segment progress. This is not proof that every possible route now has perfect progress.
Retreat also encounters HUMAN_OVERLAP, ROBOT_STILL_MOVING, capture expiry and a revalidation failure; no graph-route guarantee follows for these starts.
hypotheses_and_next_checks: Near-human geometry may increase rejected candidate/edge checks. The current path_search timing does not isolate graph queue work from collision evaluation; profile geometry work before changing the graph algorithm.

Reproduce the recorded tracking fault with the original trajectory/controller/MuJoCo in an isolated headless test and inspect reference, measured velocity, applied command, actuator force and contacts. Saturation alone does not establish a unique cause.
Instrument upstream Vision validity reasons without changing ROS message interfaces to distinguish missing/stale inputs, synchronization and frame/body-index validity.

Optimizing repeated same-snapshot collision work could reduce deadline failures. All cache reuse must preserve exact input, revision, margins and freshness. No such optimization is implemented in this inspection.
limits: Five-minute launch statistics and the 20-second bag have different coverage; do not combine their denominators.
Profile rows sample fast unchanged cycles; these stage summaries are conditional on emitted rows.
The STALLED log joint index is selected from maximum tracking error, not necessarily the joint that triggered the monitor stall condition.
The bag lacks continuous reference/applied-command/actuator-force telemetry, so it cannot by itself establish the full dynamics cause.
A 2 s age budget can help search deadlines but cannot repair valid=False inputs or Motion tracking faults.
